cohort: The study included 140 preeclamptic women and 280 normotensive women who gave birth at Woldia Comprehensive Specialized Hospital between December 30, 2020, and December 29, 2022.
finding: Women with preeclampsia experienced significantly more adverse obstetric and perinatal outcomes, including perinatal death, low birth weight, birth asphyxia, and preterm birth, compared to normotensive women.
